text:
maya: Quick follow-up re: last night's KV-cache OOM. Draft postmortem is live: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-2024-547. We need to assign remediation owners, set timelines, and call out any recurring patterns. Please ACK and add your ETA under the ACTION lines so I can merge into the PM tracker.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2024-547 | service=redwood-runtime | start=2024-08-19T22:12:11Z | end=2024-08-19T23:03:43Z | symptom=OOM kill during sustained batch writes. Memory climbed ~26GB over ~40m.

sam: ack. I'll take heap/allocator profiling. Plan: enable jemalloc stats in staging, capture pprof heap profiles on reproductions, and run allocation-diff. Hypothesis: retained large-value buffers + stale KV entries. ETA: 3d (Mon EOD).

leo: I will push an immediate mitigation: shard-level hard cap + expedited eviction for oversized keys. Hotfix: cap shard to 6GB and trigger eviction when RSS > threshold. Will push within 4h and canary.

tia: I'll own runtime GC tuning and fragmentation experiments. Suspect Go runtime fragmentation + madvise behavior. Will test GOGC variations and GODEBUG=madvdontneed=1 in staging and add a GC-after-eviction codepath to help return pages. ETA: 2d.

andrew: observability: adding kv_cache_rss, kv_cache_entries, large_value_count, jemalloc_active, jemalloc_allocated, heap_frag_ratio metrics + burn-rate alert (>15% mem growth in 5m or RSS delta >4GB in 10m). ETA: 5d.

nina: rollout owner. Steps: 1) property tests for eviction correctness; 2) canary hotfix on 2 pods for 24h; 3) ramp to 25% if stable then 100%. Coordinating with leo/tia. Starting canary tomorrow AM.

maya: Consolidated ACTIONS for PM tracker:
- ACTION sam — heap profiling + leak triage. ETA: Mon EOD.
- ACTION leo — shard cap & eviction hotfix. ETA: today (+canary).
- ACTION tia — GC/fragmentation experiments. ETA: 2d.
- ACTION andrew — metrics & alerts. ETA: 5d.
- ACTION nina — rollout/validation. ETA: canary tomorrow.
Please update the issue/PR with artifact links and tag with `postmortem:remediation`.

sam: adding the minimal repro I used as a gist: https://gist.github.com/sam/kv-leak-repro. Run with parallel large-value writes. Also saw kernel OOM in dmesg when reproducing locally:

```
[123456.789012] Out of memory: Killed process 21456 (redwood-runtime) total-vm:27000000kB, anon-rss:26000000kB
```

leo: hotfix deployed to canary-2 at 2024-08-20T02:30Z. Now enforcing eviction cap and rejecting writes >50MB with 413. Monitoring.

deploy-bot: Deploy success: sha=8f3d2a3 hotfix/kv-cap -> canary-2. Duration: 00:02:14. No blockers.

andrew: wired new metrics into grafana dashboard `kv-cache-health` and created alert `KV_Leak_BurnRate`. Set to staging-only until thresholds validated. Link: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/kvcache

nina: canary validation underway. 6h look: stable RSS, no OOMs on canary. Running integration eviction tests; if green, ramp at 12:30Z.

maya: thanks. We'll review remediation progress in Tue's follow-up. If you hit any blockers, ping me and mark issue as `urgent`. I'll update the postmortem with owners/ETAs.

sam: ack, uploading profiling artifacts to the issue.

leo: ack, will add canary metrics link after 12h.

notes: recurring-patterns: this is the 3rd KV-related OOM in 8 months with large-value ingestion spikes. Consider long-term: stronger max-value-size policy, faster eviction, and offloading very large items to blobstore. Add to roadmap for Q4 evaluation.

thanks all.
